senses.sense_definition: A form of government where power is held by a small group of people, such as the wealthy or elite.

examples.text: Critics argued that the nation had transitioned from a democracy into an <w>oligarchy</w> controlled by wealthy elites.
Many citizens feared that corporate influence would pave the way for an oppressive <w>oligarchy</w>.

senses.sense_definition: A country or state ruled by a small group of powerful individuals.

examples.text: The small island nation functioned as an <w>oligarchy</w> where a few families controlled the entire economy.
Historians studied how the ancient <w>oligarchy</w> maintained its power against repeated popular rebellions.

senses.sense_definition: The group of powerful or wealthy people who control such a government.

examples.text: The ruling <w>oligarchy</w> resisted every attempt at constitutional reform that threatened their privileges.
Members of the financial <w>oligarchy</w> met secretly to decide the outcome of the upcoming election.
